suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
optimized_sql:
SELECT item.i_item_id,
       CAST(SUM(preagg.sum_ss_quantity) AS numeric) / NULLIF(SUM(preagg.cnt_ss_quantity), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(preagg.sum_ss_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(preagg.cnt_ss_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(preagg.sum_ss_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(preagg.cnt_ss_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(preagg.sum_ss_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(preagg.cnt_ss_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_item_sk,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS sum_ss_quantity,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS cnt_ss_quantity,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS sum_ss_list_price,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS cnt_ss_list_price,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_ss_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_ss_coupon_amt,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_ss_sales_price,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk AS cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS cd ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk AS d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS dd ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN (SELECT p_promo_sk AS p_promo_sk FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AS pr ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_item_sk
) AS preagg
JOIN item ON preagg.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY item.i_item_id
ORDER BY item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
